info.title: opas
info.description: A model router for LLM requests. opas predicts each candidate model's success probability, cost and response time from an open-weight model's activations, and picks one by the quality / speed / cost weights the client sets. It serves four provider APIs as a routing proxy, plus a decision-only endpoint.

post.description: Send a request body exactly as the provider's API expects it (https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat). With `model` set to the router model (`auto`), opas picks a model; with a configured model id, the request goes straight to that model. opas rewrites `model` to the provider's name, forwards the request, and streams the response back unchanged, adding the `x-opas-*` headers. Without a server-side key for the model, the client's own credentials are forwarded.

parameters.name: x-opas-weights
parameters.description: Quality / speed / cost weights for this request, e.g. `quality=60,speed=20,cost=20`

parameters.name: x-opas-preference
parameters.description: A preset instead of weights: `quality`, `balanced`, `cost` or `speed`

parameters.name: x-opas-pricing
parameters.description: Prices for this request, USD per million tokens: `model=input/cached/output; other=input/output`

requestBody.description: A request body in the provider's format

200.description: The provider's response, unchanged (JSON, or `text/event-stream` when streaming)

x-opas-estimate.description: Routed requests: the chosen model's `p_success`, `cost_usd` and `response_time_s`

x-opas-model.description: The configured model that served the request

x-opas-previous-model.description: Continued conversations: the model that served the previous turn

x-opas-router.description: Routed requests: the router that decided (`probe` or `affinity`)

400.description: Invalid request, or the router model was requested without a router

502.description: The provider could not be reached

get.summary: List the router model and the configured models
get.description: The router model (`auto` by default, only when a router is configured) followed by the configured models. Anthropic-shaped when the request carries `anthropic-version`, OpenAI-shaped otherwise.

get.description: Each configured model's price (USD per million tokens) and where it came from: the config, models.dev, or the tier's default. Per-request prices (`x-opas-pricing`) are not included.

post.summary: Decide which model a request should go to, without sending it
post.description: Runs the router on a request body in any supported API format and returns the chosen model with every candidate's predicted success probability, cost and response time. Nothing is sent upstream.

400.description: Invalid body, empty `candidates`, invalid weights, or no router configured

404.description: A named model is not configured

AnthropicModelList.description: `GET /v1/models` in the Anthropic shape (when the request has `anthropic-version`).

ApiFormat.description: The wire format of an LLM request.

Candidate.description: A model the router may choose.

id.description: Model id as exposed by the router (matches a configured model id).

models_dev.description:
models.dev catalog key (`provider/model`) to price this candidate from, when
`pricing` is not given.

oneOf.description: Prices, if configured; used for cost estimates and cache-aware routing.
Serving speed, if configured; used for response-time estimates.
Capability tier, if configured; used by routers that predict outcomes per tier.

Conversation.description: What is known about the conversation a request continues.

cached_tokens.description:
Estimated prompt tokens likely cached at the previous model's provider: system
prompt, tools, and the history up to the previous turn.

previous_model.description: Model that served the previous turn.

ErrorResponse.description:
Errors from opas itself use the error shape of the API the request was made in.
This is the OpenAI shape, used by `/v1/route` and the OpenAI-format endpoints;
Anthropic-format endpoints wrap it as `{"type": "error", "error": {...}}`, and
Gemini Interactions use `{"error": {"code", "message", "status"}}`.

Estimate.description: A router's prediction for one candidate model, with its scores.

cached_prompt_tokens.description:
Prompt tokens billed at the cached price (warm prompt cache of the model that
served the previous turn).

cost_score.description: Cost score: 1 for the cheapest candidate, 0 at COST_RANGE× pricier.

expected_cost_usd.description: Expected cost of the request on this model, in USD.

expected_response_time_s.description:
Expected time until the complete response, in seconds: time to first token +
output tokens / output speed. Per request (one turn), not per multi-call task.

p_success.description: Predicted probability that the model answers successfully (0..1).

quality_score.description: Quality score: p_success relative to the best candidate (1 for the best).

score.description: Weighted average of the three scores; the router picks the highest.

speed_score.description: Speed score: 1 for the fastest candidate, 0 at TIME_RANGE× slower.

enabled.description: Whether prices are fetched from models.dev.

priced_models.description: Number of models in the loaded catalog (0 until the first fetch succeeds).

PriceSource.description: Where a resolved price came from.

Pricing.description: Per-model prices in USD per million tokens.

cached_input.description: Price of input tokens read from the prompt cache.

oneOf.description:
Higher prices that apply when the prompt exceeds a context size, as some
providers charge (e.g. above 100k or 200k tokens).

models.description: The price in effect for each configured model.

ResolvedPrice.description: A model's resolved price and where it came from.

candidates.description: Models to choose between. Defaults to the configured models that serve `api`.

pricing.description:
Prices by model id for this request (USD per million tokens), overriding the
operator's and models.dev prices.

request.description: A request body in that format, exactly as it would be sent to the proxy endpoint.

oneOf.description: Quality / speed / cost weights. Defaults to the router's (60 / 20 / 20).

RouteResponse.description: A routing decision, with every candidate's estimates.

oneOf.description: The conversation this request continued, if opas recognized one.

decision_id.description: Unique id of the decision, also logged by opas.

estimates.description: Every candidate's predictions and scores, best first.

model.description: The chosen model (a configured model id, or one of `candidates`).

router.description:
The router that decided: `probe`, or `affinity` when the request continues
provider-stored state that lives on one model.

upstream_model.description: The provider's name for the chosen model, when it is a configured model.

Speed.description: How fast a model answers, for response-time estimates.

output_tokens_per_sec.description: Output tokens per second once generation starts.

ttft_s.description: Time to first token, in seconds.

Weights.description: Relative importance of quality, speed and cost. Only the ratios matter.
